name: 3D Voxel Line Traversal (Accumulating Error)
definition: An algorithm to visit all voxel cells intersected by a line segment between two arbitrary 3D points (gx0, gy0, gz0) and (gx1, gy1, gz1). It solves the problem of standard Bresenham skipping cells by using an accumulating error term scaled by the product of axis deltas.
summary: Wivlaro's algorithm visits every voxel intersected by a line segment by using an accumulating error term scaled by axis delta products to prevent skipping cells.
